title: Salvianolic acid B inhibits hepatic stellate cell activation and liver fibrosis by targeting PDGFRbeta.
authors: Liu, Fangbin; Li, Shengnan; Chen, Panpan; Gu, Yanqiu; Wang, Shaozhan; Wang, Lei; Chen, Chun; Wang, Rong; Yuan, Yongfang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Salvianolic acid B通过靶向PDGFRbeta抑制肝星状细胞活化与肝纤维化，属于药物-蛋白互作及湿实验验证，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Liver fibrosis is a reversible pathological process and a wound healing response to liver injury. As an early stage of various liver diseases, liver fibrosis can develop into cirrhosis, liver failure, and even liver cancer if not controlled in time. Salvia miltiorrhiza is a medicinal plant with hepatoprotective effects. Salvianolic acid B (Sal B) is the representative component of S. miltiorrhiza. Many studies have reported the anti-liver fibrosis effects and mechanisms of Sal B. However, the direct anti-fibrotic targets of Sal B have not yet been reported. Platelet-derived growth factor receptor beta (PDGFRbeta) is one of the most classical targets in liver fibrosis, which is closely related to hepatic stellate cells (HSCs) activated. Previously, we established and applied a PDGFRbeta affinity chromatography model, and found that Sal B binds well to PDGFRbeta. Therefore, this study aimed to investigate the direct targets of Sal B against liver fibrosis. We confirmed the binding ability of Sal B to PDGFRbeta by molecular docking and a surface plasmon resonance biosensor. Our findings indicated that Sal B targeted PDGFRbeta to inhibit the activation, migration and proliferation of HSCs and suppressed the PDGF-BB-induced PDGFRbeta signaling pathway. Annexin V-FITC/PI assay showed that Sal B reversed the PDGF-BB-induced decrease in HSC apoptosis rate. In the mouse liver fibrosis model, Sal B inhibited the PDGFRbeta signaling pathway, HSC activation and reduced inflammatory response, ultimately improved CCl(4)-induced liver fibrosis. In summary, the direct anti-fibrotic targets of Sal B may be PDGFRbeta, and this study clarified the anti-liver fibrosis effects and mechanism of Sal B.
abstract_zh: 肝纤维化是一种可逆的病理过程，也是对肝损伤的伤口愈合反应。作为多种肝脏疾病的早期阶段，肝纤维化若未及时控制，可发展为肝硬化、肝衰竭，甚至肝癌。丹参是一种具有保肝作用的药用植物。丹酚酸B（Sal B）是丹参的代表性成分。许多研究已报道Sal B的抗肝纤维化作用及其机制。然而，Sal B的直接抗纤维化靶点尚未见报道。血小板衍生生长因子受体β（PDGFRbeta）是肝纤维化中最经典的靶点之一，与肝星状细胞（HSCs）的活化密切相关。此前，我们建立并应用了PDGFRbeta亲和色谱模型，发现Sal B与PDGFRbeta结合良好。因此，本研究旨在探讨Sal B抗肝纤维化的直接靶点。我们通过分子对接和表面等离子共振生物传感器确认了Sal B与PDGFRbeta的结合能力。我们的研究结果表明，Sal B靶向PDGFRbeta，抑制HSCs的活化、迁移和增殖，并抑制PDGF-BB诱导的PDGFRbeta信号通路。Annexin V-FITC/PI检测显示，Sal B逆转了PDGF-BB诱导的HSC凋亡率下降。在小鼠肝纤维化模型中，Sal B抑制了PDGFRbeta信号通路、HSC活化，并减轻了炎症反应，最终改善了CCl(4)诱导的肝纤维化。总之，Sal B的直接抗纤维化靶点可能是PDGFRbeta，本研究阐明了Sal B的抗肝纤维化作用及其机制。
